field_principles.gatemate_openfpgaloader_installed: Records the GateMate root blocker honestly.
field_principles.inference_substrate: SSH-attached board tests plus a disk check; no live model inference.
field_principles.kv260_mandate_lift_recommendation: Operator-action recommendation for lifting the per-milestone KV260 mandate once terminal.
field_principles.kv260_overlay_loaded: Confirms the carnot_ising overlay is the latest real-board-deployable bitstream.
field_principles.kv260_terminal_condition_confirmed: Bare bool: overlay confirmation plus non-fabricated transcript means KV260 is terminal.
field_principles.kv260_terminal_transcript_present: True iff the Exp 3709 non-fabricated board-latency transcript exists on disk with at least 30 samples.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Records per-board reachability checks, including the correct KV260 SSH precondition rather than host SD-card state.
field_principles.speedup_claim_avoided_assert: Asserts no thermalization, equilibrium, or comparative hardware-speedup claim is made.

gatemate_known_blocker: flash/smoke host-IO hang blocker recorded; flash and smoke not run
narrowing_scope: POC functional latency anchor only; no comparative CPU claim.
